subject: Renewal request: EU primary + APAC standby — residency carveouts & DR details
messages:
From: Lukas Berg <lukas.berg@healthnord.eu>
To: Soojin Lee <soojin.lee@redwood.com>, procurement@healthnord.eu
Date: 2026-09-28T08:15:00+00:00
Subject: Upcoming renewal & residency carveouts - initial ask

Hi Soojin,

Our annual renewal window is approaching and we want to firm up a geography/residency approach before the contract term. High-level asks from our security and legal teams: 

- Primary serving and data residency inside EU for PHI-adjacent workloads; non-PHI test/analytics traffic can be routed via APAC for performance testing.
- APAC to be configured as a warm-standby (standby-only active during DR or scheduled bursts) with documented failover RTO/RPO.
- A carveout so that specific patient-identifiable request logs and raw transcripts remain in EU-only buckets; analytics events may be aggregated and exported out of region.
- Key management: we need KMS integration or BYOK for the EU node.
- Proofs: a short snapshot of SOC2 evidence and a sample audit log export for our compliance team.

Can you and your team propose a renewal amendment that includes pricing for the EU Dedicated node + warm APAC standby, a failover runbook, and any material changes to SLAs/term length? We are targeting a Nov 1 effective date.

Thanks,
Lukas
Head of Platform Engineering
HealthNord AB

From: Soojin Lee <soojin.lee@redwood.com>
To: Lukas Berg <lukas.berg@healthnord.eu>
Cc: ben_carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>, marissa_cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, monica_patel <monica_patel@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-09-29T10:02:00+00:00
Subject: Re: Upcoming renewal & residency carveouts - initial ask

Hi Lukas — thanks for the clear summary. Looping in Ben (Sales), Marissa (Customer Success) and Monica (Infra Ops) so we can respond with a combined commercial + technical amendment.

Quick notes and next steps from our side:

- We can provision an EU Dedicated pool and support a labeled-data carveout for transcript/raw logs. That will be implemented via per-route policies and an EU-only storage class; we will include language in the amendment to guarantee residency for the listed data classes.
- APAC as warm-standby is supported; we typically implement this as an active-passive deployment with automated health checks and a documented failover checklist. Typical warm-standby RTO we target is 15–30 minutes for session-level routing, depending on KV cache warmup characteristics. We will include an explicit RTO/RPO table in the SOW.
- BYOK/KMS: we support customer-managed keys for private deployments and can integrate with your KMS via our Private control-plane. For Hosted/Dedicated, we offer a KMS integration path; Monica will confirm exact integrations and constraints.
- Attachments: Ben will attach an updated SOW draft with capacity and pricing options; Marissa will outline a short onboarding checklist and can run a compliance walk-through with your InfoSec.

Proposed immediate cadence:
- Ben sends updated SOW + three commercial options (EU-only reserved, EU + APAC standby, EU + APAC standby + analytics egress controls) — by EOD 2026-10-01.
- Technical appendix (Monica) with failover steps and KMS notes — by 2026-10-02.
- Quick 30-min call next week to align on carveouts and sign-off path.

Does Thursday 2026-10-07 at 09:00 CET work for a sync?

Best,

— Soojin Lee
Senior Customer Success Manager
Redwood Inference
soojin.lee@redwood.com
+1 (415) 555-0128

From: ben_carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>
To: Lukas Berg <lukas.berg@healthnord.eu>
Cc: Soojin Lee <soojin.lee@redwood.com>, marissa_cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, monica_patel <monica_patel@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-10-01T14:35:00+00:00
Subject: Re: Upcoming renewal & residency carveouts - initial ask

Lukas — attaching the SOW draft and a commercial appendix with three SKU options, as Soojin summarized. See attachments: Redwood_SOW_v2.pdf (includes RTO/RPO table) and Redwood_Commercial_Options.xlsx (pricing tiers).

High-level pricing bullets:
- Option A (EU Dedicated, 12-month term): reserved capacity, best-effort burst to APAC disabled — list price EUR 68k/mo.
- Option B (EU Dedicated + APAC warm-standby, 12-month term): warm-standby included, automated failover + 2h DR runbook training — list price EUR 82k/mo.
- Option C (EU Dedicated + APAC warm-standby + analytics egress control): adds per-route egress filters and audit exports — EUR 90k/mo.

A few contractual notes for procurement/legal:
- We can add a residency guarantee clause limited to the data classes you specify (transcripts, raw request bodies). We will include an appendix that enumerates the data classes and an audit process.
- KMS/BYOK: available as an add-on with a short SOW for private key management; integration is region-specific and will require a connectivity review.
- DocuSign link for the SOW will be posted after final commercial selection.

I included an inline comment (SOW p.7) suggesting a 30-day notice for any cross-region egress requests so we can schedule capacity and preserve the residency guarantees. Open to negotiating that for procurement-friendly language.

Thanks — happy to join the 10/07 call.

Attachments: Redwood_SOW_v2.pdf (23 pages), Redwood_Commercial_Options.xlsx

— Ben Carter
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
ben_carter@redwood.com
+1 (415) 555-0166

From: Lukas Berg <lukas.berg@healthnord.eu>
To: Soojin Lee <soojin.lee@redwood.com>
Cc: ben_carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>, marissa_cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, monica_patel <monica_patel@redwood.com>, procurement@healthnord.eu
Date: 2026-10-05T09:23:00+00:00
Subject: Re: Upcoming renewal & residency carveouts - initial ask

Thanks everyone for the quick turnaround and the draft SOW. A few clarifications from our side after internal review: 

- We prefer Option B but with a stricter RTO commitment for the most sensitive workloads: target RTO 10 minutes for route-level failover of API traffic that uses EU-held transcripts. We understand this may involve higher warm cache retention; please flag any cost delta.
- BYOK/KMS: we need HSM-backed keys and an exported audit trail for key usage. If that requires a Private deployment of the control plane, flag it clearly in the SOW.
- Audit/export: procurement requests a sample daily audit export (anonymized) for the last 7 days as part of the Security appendix to validate residency claims. We appreciate the SOC2 snapshot you attached — please also include a short guide to pulling per-tenant audit logs.

We are prepared to move forward once the SOW includes: the 10-minute RTO option for a quantified subset of routes, explicit KMS/HSM language, and the sample audit export instructions. If you can provide updated SOW by 2026-10-11 we can route to procurement and legal for final sign-off ahead of Nov 1.

Also: Thursday 2026-10-07 09:00 CET works for the sync call — please send calendar invite.

Best,
Lukas
Head of Platform Engineering
HealthNord AB
